calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT category
FROM dim_product
WHERE category LIKE '%Garden%' OR category LIKE '%Electrical%'
ORDER BY category;

SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_period = 8
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC;

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  p.category,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8
  AND p.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, p.category
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year, p.category;

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.category,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26,
  ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END)) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 
    2
  ) AS growth_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8
  AND p.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category;

Garden | 59501.02 | 39146.83 | -34.21

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS line_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipt_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.store_key) AS store_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year;

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  p.category,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag = TRUE THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS staff_purchase_net_amount,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_net_amount,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag = TRUE THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(f.net_amount) * 100, 2) AS staff_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8
  AND p.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, p.category
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year, p.category;
